# JWillum products

> Small offline browser tools that turn CSV exports from Stripe, QuickBooks, Xero, Shopify, Etsy, Faire, Whatnot, Toggl, Clockify and Harvest into clean files. Every tool is $8 one-time on Gumroad, runs locally in the browser, and needs no account, no subscription and no upload.

- Website: https://jwillumproducts.github.io/
- All tools: https://jwillumproducts.github.io/tools/
- All guides: https://jwillumproducts.github.io/guides/
- Store: https://willumsen4.gumroad.com/
- Contact: jwillum.products@gmail.com
- The tools do not sync with Shopify, QuickBooks or Xero; they create files you import yourself.
- Independent; not affiliated with Stripe, Shopify, Intuit, Xero, Wave, Etsy, Faire, Whatnot, Toggl, Clockify, Harvest or Avery.
- Refunds: see each product page on Gumroad for its refund policy.
- Full guide text: https://jwillumproducts.github.io/llms-full.txt

## Payments & bookkeeping

- [StripeClear Journal](https://jwillumproducts.github.io/tools/stripeclear-journal/): Turn a Stripe Balance Transactions CSV into a balanced QuickBooks Online journal CSV, plus a payout summary and an audit file. $8 one-time. Buy: https://willumsen4.gumroad.com/l/stripeclear-journal (Gumroad name: Stripe Balance Transactions CSV to QuickBooks Journal — Offline)
- [BooksExport Clean](https://jwillumproducts.github.io/tools/books-export-clean/): Clean QuickBooks Online or Xero export CSVs for accountant handoff: junk rows stripped, ISO dates and normalized amounts. Not tax advice. $8 one-time. Buy: https://willumsen4.gumroad.com/l/books-export-clean (Gumroad name: QuickBooks Xero Export CSV Cleaner — Offline Accountant Handoff)
- [Tracker Invoice Lines](https://jwillumproducts.github.io/tools/tracker-invoice-lines/): Turn a Toggl, Clockify or Harvest detailed time CSV into Xero, Wave or generic Qty × Rate invoice line CSVs. $8 one-time. Buy: https://willumsen4.gumroad.com/l/tracker-invoice-lines (Gumroad name: Toggl Clockify Harvest to Xero Wave Lines — Offline Invoice CSV)

## Shopify & Etsy

- [Shopify CSV Densifier](https://jwillumproducts.github.io/tools/shopify-csv-densifier/): Fill the blank order-level cells in a Shopify Orders CSV, then trim it to Pick, Pack or 3PL column presets. $8 one-time. Buy: https://willumsen4.gumroad.com/l/shopify-csv-densifier (Gumroad name: Shopify Orders CSV Densifier — Offline Pick, Pack & 3PL Presets)
- [Shopify Customers MailMerge](https://jwillumproducts.github.io/tools/shopify-customers-mailmerge/): Turn a Shopify Customers CSV into clean US, UK, CA, AU or generic mail-merge address columns. $8 one-time. Buy: https://willumsen4.gumroad.com/l/shopify-customers-mailmerge (Gumroad name: Shopify Customers CSV Mail Merge — Offline US UK CA AU Packs)
- [Etsy Listing CSV Fixer](https://jwillumproducts.github.io/tools/etsy-listing-csv-fixer/): Validate and safely clean Etsy listing export CSVs, then download a cleaned file and an issue report. $8 one-time. Buy: https://willumsen4.gumroad.com/l/etsy-listing-csv-fixer (Gumroad name: Etsy Listing Export CSV Cleaner — Offline Validate & Fix)

## Marketplace fees & profit

- [Faire Wholesale Fee & Profit Calculator](https://jwillumproducts.github.io/tools/faire-profit-calculator/): See what you keep on Faire: compare Marketplace and Direct orders, the new-retailer fee and payout speed, with bulk CSV and break-even pricing. $8 one-time. Buy: https://willumsen4.gumroad.com/l/faire-profit-calculator (Gumroad name: Faire Wholesale Fee & Profit Calculator — Offline Net After Fees)
- [Whatnot Seller Profit Calculator](https://jwillumproducts.github.io/tools/whatnot-profit-calculator/): See what you keep on Whatnot after category commission and payment processing, with bulk CSV and a show-night print sheet. $8 one-time. Buy: https://willumsen4.gumroad.com/l/whatnot-profit-calculator (Gumroad name: Whatnot Seller Profit Calculator — Offline Net After Fees (Cliff + CSV + Show Print))

## Events

- [Event QR Badges](https://jwillumproducts.github.io/tools/event-qr-badges/): Turn an attendee CSV into printable Avery 5395-compatible name badges and fold-up table tents with vCard QR codes. $8 one-time. Buy: https://willumsen4.gumroad.com/l/event-qr-badges (Gumroad name: Avery 5395-Compatible Name Badges & QR Table Tents from CSV — Offline)

## Free tools

- [Marketplace Fee Calculator](https://jwillumproducts.github.io/tools/marketplace-fee-calculator/): A free spreadsheet that compares fees, profit and margin on Etsy, Whatnot and Faire side by side, with US default rates you can edit. $0+ (pay what you want). Get it: https://willumsen4.gumroad.com/l/marketplace-fee-calculator
- [Stripe Payout Check](https://jwillumproducts.github.io/tools/stripeclear-journal/check/): free in-browser check that a Stripe balance CSV reconciles (per-category totals, gross − fee = net row check, payout total). No upload, no export.
